title: What If Nobody Ever Washed Their Hands Again?

scenes.text: What if the whole world stopped washing hands? One small habit holds back a lot of disease.
Washing with soap cuts diarrhea in children under five by about 30 percent.
It also cuts their respiratory infections by about 20 percent.
Those two illnesses, diarrhea and pneumonia, are the leading killers of young children worldwide.
Over more than a million deaths a year are tied to them, and handwashing is one of the cheapest defenses.
No vaccine, no new drug. Just soap and twenty seconds. That's what you'd be giving up.
